incidents.attacker: Russia — GRU military intelligence (primary cluster, Cyclops Blink malware); criminal ransomware operator (Qilin); unknown credential-theft cluster
incidents.vector: Authentication bypass in Cisco Firepower Management Center (CVE-2026-20079, CVSS 10.0) and a secondary information-disclosure flaw (CVE-2026-20316) exploited simultaneously by three distinct threat clusters
incidents.impact: Russia-linked actors deployed Cyclops Blink malware across network security infrastructure; a criminal operator deployed Qilin ransomware; a third cluster harvested credentials. Active exploitation of a CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated remote code execution flaw with no workaround short of patching.

incidents.victim: US defense contractors, NGOs, Southeast Asian governments
incidents.attacker: China — Ministry of State Security (MSS), four coordinated espionage units sharing identical exploit kit
incidents.vector: Shared zero-day browser exploit kit (BlueMoon) targeting Google Chrome distributed and coordinated across at least four China-linked espionage groups
incidents.impact: Four China-linked espionage units used an identical browser zero-day to compromise US defense contractors, civil society organizations, and Southeast Asian government networks; investigation ongoing and patch gap scope unconfirmed.

incidents.victim: IDScan.net (Louisiana identity verification company) / 153M+ US and Canadian citizens
incidents.vector: Intrusion into identity verification company's database resulting in exfiltration of over 153 million driver's license records now offered for sale on dark web marketplace 'Nexus'
incidents.impact: 153 million US and Canadian driver's licenses listed for sale on dark web; FBI investigation launched; victims face large-scale identity fraud exposure across all affected states and provinces.

incidents.vector: Vendor API credential theft enabling unauthorized access to EHR systems and exfiltration of 3.5 million patient records including Social Security numbers
incidents.impact: Gentlemen ransomware gang claimed exfiltration of 3.5 million patient records including Social Security numbers; company filed SEC Form 8-K material cybersecurity incident disclosure.

incidents.victim: PyPI, npm, Docker Hub users; AI coding tool users (global developer ecosystem)
incidents.vector: Malicious packages published to PyPI, npm, and Docker Hub registries embedding DUSTMAKER backdoor, specifically engineered to target AI coding environments including .claude/ directories, VS Code, and Cursor, and to poison CI/CD pipelines
incidents.impact: Large-scale developer supply chain compromise harvesting secrets from AI coding tools and poisoning build pipelines; two group members arrested in Australia but operations ongoing.

incidents.victim: Microsoft Windows, Office, and Azure users (global)
incidents.vector: Two zero-days (CVE-2026-81963, CVE-2026-85880) actively exploited in the wild among a record 974 vulnerabilities patched, including 20 wormable bugs and CVSS 9.8 Netlogon and DNS remote code execution flaws
incidents.impact: Record 974 CVEs patched in a single cycle; two zero-days confirmed exploited at patch release; 20 wormable vulnerabilities and multiple CVSS 9.8 RCEs require priority emergency patching across enterprise environments.

incidents.attacker: China — state-affiliated AI companies (DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun, Z.AI)
incidents.vector: Industrial-scale automated querying of US frontier AI models to extract training data and capabilities via knowledge distillation, effectively bypassing US AI export controls
incidents.impact: CISA, NSA, and FBI joint advisory documents systematic extraction of billions of tokens from US AI models since late 2024; approach effectively circumvents export restrictions and erodes US competitive advantage in frontier AI without any single exploitable vulnerability.

incidents.vector: Network intrusion on August 25 causing global IT systems outage affecting manufacturing, order processing, distribution, and sterilization systems
incidents.impact: Attack caused global manufacturing and distribution disruption; company confirmed it will not meet 2026 revenue or adjusted EPS guidance targets; SEC Form 8-K material incident update filed; cardiac remote monitoring restored but investigation ongoing.

incidents.victim: Adobe Commerce and Magento e-commerce operators (global)
incidents.vector: Unpatched zero-day vulnerability (StyleSmugglar) in Adobe Commerce and Magento actively exploited since September 5 with no vendor patch available at time of reporting
incidents.impact: E-commerce operators exposed to active exploitation with no patch; CISA added to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog; attackers likely targeting cardholder payment data and customer PII.

incidents.vector: Authentication bypass in MikroTik's custom SSH daemon allows SSH key spoofing to gain unauthorized access to any user account without valid credentials
incidents.impact: Active exploitation of network routers; patch released; compromised devices show 'ops' user account added as indicator of compromise; no public exploit available but active exploitation underway.

incidents.attacker: Russia — state-linked espionage group (ClearFake / Amatera campaign)
incidents.vector: ClearFake WebDAV social engineering lure delivering Amatera credential stealer and remote access tool to Ukrainian government employees
incidents.impact: Russia-linked actors deployed credential stealer and remote access tool against a Ukrainian government organization, enabling persistent access and intelligence collection.

incidents.victim: Brazilian government and education servers (~30 institutions)
incidents.vector: Compromise of approximately 30 Brazilian government and educational institution servers repurposed as reverse-proxy relay infrastructure for SEO fraud operations
incidents.impact: Government and university servers weaponized as SEO fraud infrastructure; operational disruption and reputational risk to affected agencies; scope of data access to sensitive government systems unknown.

incidents.victim: Springfield Public Schools (MA) and Everett City Hall (MA)
incidents.vector: Ransomware-likely cyberattack against shared or adjacent municipal IT systems causing school and city government shutdowns
incidents.impact: 23,000-student school district closed and Everett city government operations disrupted; recovery timeline and extent of data exposure not yet determined.

incidents.vector: Exploitation of an unspecified vulnerability in Liquid Network's Bitcoin exchange infrastructure enabling theft of $320 million in Bitcoin
incidents.impact: Attacker returned approximately 85% of stolen funds (~$272M) and retained ~$50M claiming it as a 'white hat bug bounty'; net loss approximately $50M; vulnerability details not publicly disclosed.

incidents.vector: Four-year business email compromise (BEC) campaign against French notary offices using fraudulent wire transfer requests impersonating real estate clients
incidents.impact: €35 million stolen from 500+ notary offices over four years; ANSSI involved in investigation; case highlights persistent BEC risk in high-value real estate transactions.

incidents.vector: ClickFix social engineering lure delivered Rhysida ransomware to Berlin city government systems
incidents.impact: Government data encrypted and exfiltrated; Rhysida published stolen data after city refused $2 million ransom demand, exposing sensitive municipal records publicly.

incidents.vector: Ransomware attack targeting shared healthcare IT infrastructure affecting 80+ medical practices simultaneously
incidents.impact: 80+ Luxembourg medical practices had systems encrypted, disrupting patient care and access to medical records; attack vector and data exposure scope under investigation.

incidents.vector: Criminal actor used frontier AI models to plan and execute a full attack kill chain in under 10 hours, employing 50+ MITRE ATT&CK techniques including automated lateral movement and credential harvesting
incidents.impact: Source code exfiltrated and cloud AI compute infrastructure hijacked; case demonstrates frontier AI dramatically reducing attack execution time and skill threshold, making advanced intrusion operations accessible to less-sophisticated threat actors.

incidents.victim: US cryptocurrency fraud victims (all 50 states and territories)
incidents.attacker: Criminal gang — fraud (Southeast Asian scam center operators)
incidents.vector: Southeast Asian transnational criminal organizations operating industrial-scale scam compounds use fake personas, romance schemes, and fraudulent investment platforms to convince victims to transfer cryptocurrency
incidents.impact: FinCEN analysis of 33,904 Bank Secrecy Act reports identifies $12.7 billion in suspected digital asset investment fraud from September 2023 through December 2025, affecting victims in all 50 states.

incidents.victim: Mexican government and transportation sector; Brazilian financial sector
incidents.vector: Criminal groups used frontier AI models to assist with attack planning, phishing content generation, and exploitation against Latin American government and financial targets
incidents.impact: Two confirmed AI-assisted intrusion campaigns against Mexican government and transportation (CL-CRI-1131) and Brazilian financial sector (CL-CRI-1163); extent of data theft under investigation.

incidents.vector: Voice phishing (vishing) attacks conducted via Microsoft Teams, impersonating IT support or vendors to harvest credentials and deliver malware
incidents.impact: 150+ employees targeted across 10+ organizations; credential theft enabling follow-on access to corporate systems and potentially downstream ransomware deployment.

incidents.vector: TeamCity CI/CD server vulnerability exploited to breach JetBrains' Cadence cloud LLM training and development platform
incidents.impact: Source code and credentials potentially stolen from cloud AI training platform; risk of downstream exposure to Cadence customers who may have training data or models hosted on the platform.

incidents.vector: Ransomware attack encrypting Bavarian municipal utility IT systems
incidents.impact: IT systems encrypted at municipal energy and services utility; customer data potentially exfiltrated; service delivery impact and recovery timeline under investigation.

incidents.vector: HOOKEDGE batch-file backdoor deployed against European diplomatic missions via spearphishing; campaign ran from September 2025 through April 2026
incidents.impact: Russian military intelligence maintained persistent access to diplomatic networks in three European countries for approximately seven months, enabling intelligence collection on European diplomatic communications and foreign policy deliberations.
